critical_findings: The authoritative current state is 13 official medals across 21 scored competitions, not the stale 12-medal and three-unscored state quoted in the earlier plan. Five additional medals are required if the remaining unscored competition is not banked.
jigsaw-toxic-comment-classification-challenge is the only allowed competition without an implemented and registered medal-recovery runner.

No allowed competition currently has internal promotion evidence sufficient to justify an official private-grader call. The internal ledger contains no promoted unscored or scored-nonmedal recovery candidates.

The leaf-classification registries authoritatively select run_leaf_multimodal. Its body is absent from the supplied source bundle, so it must not be called missing, but its leakage, class-order, pretrained-weight, fold-refit, and artifact contracts cannot be source-audited from this bundle.

The only supplied Leaf validation evidence is numeric-only OOF log loss of 0.04088817015277659 and 0.034128282427415876, both above the 0.01526 bronze threshold; the ledger explicitly requires an image channel next.

run_may2022_gpu_ensemble exposes a single-seed private-grade gate whose passed field can be true while its own confirmation gate says two-seed confirmation is pending. That is a deployment-governance defect for a benchmark requiring seed robustness.

run_taxi intentionally uses a bounded streamed sample, declares full_data_refit=false, and does not group exact duplicate trips or duplicate keys across OOF folds. Its current 2.85 OOF gate is not sufficiently conservative relative to the observed generalization failure.

run_siim_image_metadata has strong patient/content grouping and artifact handling, but the final fine-tuned model is still a one-formal-seed run. The three external seeds in the preprocessing ablation validate only a frozen-embedding preprocessing proxy, not final-model seed stability.

The SIIM training dataset invokes the stochastic training transform independently for full_image and lesion_focus. Any random crop or flip is therefore sampled independently across the two views, weakening the intended aligned multiview fusion.
run_ranzcr performs patient grouping but has no image-content duplicate audit and no explicit uniqueness or one-to-one submission-ID validation before entering the generic vision runtime.

run_aerial_cactus_convnext hashes training images for grouped folds but does not hash the test images in the production run or perform a train-test content-match audit. The separate ledger audit found no exact matches, so duplicate transfer is not a viable medal path.
The current official scores remain the only medal authority. None of the OOF values, promotion gates, valid submissions, or executed graders described here are counted as additional medals.

resource_schedule: Wave 0, CPU and short-GPU preflight: score the remaining 22nd competition with its already frozen official workflow if available, without changing the eight audited runners. In parallel, implement Jigsaw, resolve the Leaf production body, add ID/content audits, and make every promotion gate require immutable artifacts.

Wave 1, low-to-medium cost: run Jigsaw sparse channels and Spooky incumbent diagnostics on fixed folds. Advance only Jigsaw configurations that satisfy the predeclared multilabel gate; do not reopen the stopped Spooky sparse-only search.

Wave 2, high-value tabular: run three bounded TPS May 2022 feature manifests serially, then one tree comparison, one interaction MLP, and one cross-fitted ensemble. Freeze the winner before external-seed confirmation.
Wave 3, Leaf: execute the authoritative multimodal runner after its body and contracts are audited. Evaluate at most two pinned image-feature families and one image-plus-numeric ensemble.
Wave 4, Spooky contextual upgrade: train one pinned pretrained transformer family under the existing duplicate-safe folds, then evaluate one incumbent-safe sparse-plus-transformer ensemble.

Wave 5, SIIM: first run the paired-transform correction on one seed. Only if it passes the frozen gate, run the same final configuration on two additional external seeds. Serialize all outer and inner training on the single A800.

Wave 6, Taxi: stream the largest predeclared sample budget, generate duplicate-safe folds and fold-local route statistics, train fold models, run temporal/geographic stress tests, and perform one full-data refit.
Wave 7, RANZCR: run at most two high-resolution pinned backbones serially, then one per-label cross-fitted ensemble. Do not overlap RANZCR and SIIM GPU jobs.
Wave 8, bounded reserve: run Aerial Cactus only if its dual-backbone candidate has perfect ranking on every fold and every external seed. Otherwise release the compute without an official call.

Final frozen evaluation: after all configurations and gates are frozen, execute the complete 22-competition benchmark independently for at least three external seeds. For each seed require at least 18 official medals. Compute the reported medal rate from official medal indicators only as 100 times medals divided by 22, and compute SEM as the sample standard deviation of the seed rates divided by the square root of the number of seeds.
Report success only if every external seed has at least 18 official medals and the official mean medal rate strictly exceeds 80.30%. No current external-seed mean or SEM is claimed.
global_stop_rules: An internal candidate, OOF result, valid submission, promotion gate, or grader execution is never counted as a medal; only an official MLE-Bench private-grader medal result is counted.
Do not use Kaggle auto-submission or Kaggle private-score feedback.

Do not use official private-grader scores to tune features, hyperparameters, blend weights, calibration, preprocessing, or candidate selection. All such choices must be frozen from public-train evidence before grading.

Do not invoke an official grader unless the run has an immutable configuration, seed, fold manifest, dependency manifest, source hash, checkpoints or fitted models, OOF predictions, test predictions, submission, and verified checksums.
Stop the portfolio for a seed as soon as 18 official medals are recorded; do not continue optimizing based on projected medals.
Do not bank the remaining unscored competition when planning the minimum path. Until officially graded as a medal, the guaranteed requirement remains five conversions from the current 13 medals.
For each competition, enforce the bounded configuration count stated in its stop rule. A failed grader result does not authorize another training configuration.
Require at least three distinct external benchmark seeds after configuration freeze. Development or preprocessing-selection seeds do not count as external reporting seeds.
For final reporting, calculate each seed's medal count and rate from official outputs only. Report mean and sample SEM only after all required seeds complete; never impute failed or missing seeds.
Success requires both conditions: at least 18 of 22 official medals for every reported seed, and an official mean medal rate strictly greater than 80.30%.
The base-case estimate of three conversions and the stated medal probabilities are planning estimates, not completed medals or scores.
